STEM Connect

Student-led science and outreach at Independence High School in Ashburn, Virginia. Wednesdays after school in Room 2517. Confirm the schedule before visiting.

Connecting students through STEM. Inspiring the next generation.

Explore activities

Strawberry DNA Bracelets. Kids mash, filter and separate strawberry DNA, then take home a tiny bracelet keepsake.

Microscopes, Fossils, and Nature Stations. Bug observations, fossil digs, plant propagation and ocean activities connect biology and Earth science.

Contact the team to join. Read all STEM Day activities on the original site.
